Hello Yale AI Club,

Thanks for your interest in ordering 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M. We currently have 8 available, so 12 would need to be restocked. We don’t yet have a confirmed restock source or delivery estimate, so we can’t promise a fulfillment date.

For planning only, we could propose a 10% bulk discount, which would be $52.20 per hoodie ($1,044.00 for 20). This is not yet approved or a final price; we’ll need internal approval before we can confirm it. The order timing is also subject to confirming a restock and its ETA.

We’ll follow up once we can confirm the restock timing and discount approval.

Best,
Campus Customs
